sites.name: One chamber
sites.summary: A single air-filled chamber, 6 m on a side, 15 m down in bare Giza limestone. The simplest thing any method must find.

sites.name: Giza plateau
sites.summary: Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure on Mokattam limestone, with the chambers and passages already surveyed inside and beneath them.

sites.name: Giza depths
sites.summary: The same plateau down to 1,500 m: the published-style method's pictures drawn over their whole depth axis, as the published pictures draw them, beside the structures claimed beneath Khafre.

sites.name: Sacsayhuamán
sites.summary: The Inca walls above Cusco, the Rodadero outcrop and the city's houses, in one satellite pass: what each method draws over megalithic walls, beside houses and open fields.
